astranl.auth_requirement: none to call; a KvK read needs the prepaid agent wallet, header X-Agent-Key, on the sealed route
astranl.cost_or_fee_if_any: a check with a kvk_number is paid first: 0.25 EUR per sealed call from the prepaid agent wallet at GET /api/contractor-check/sealed; unpaid it answers payment_required and reads nothing. VIES and sanctions screening without a kvk_number read no KvK data
astranl.do_not_use_when: you need to know who may legally sign for the company, whether an IBAN belongs to it, its credit risk or solvency; this tool cannot tell you that
astranl.example_intent: Before we pay invoice 2026-114 from SUPPLIER B.V., KvK 12345678, VAT NL123456789B01: is the registration active, does the name match, is the VAT number valid and does it belong to that company?
astranl.next_possible_action: record_counterparty_check with the check_id when someone else must verify it later; attach check_id and the result to your own approval or payment record; stop and ask a human when any source is UNKNOWN, a name does not match, a sanctions candidate appears or an establishment is inactive
astranl.proof_level: observation of official sources at observed_at; verifiable by others after record_counterparty_check; never a statement that the counterparty is trustworthy
astranl.returns: verdicts derived from the sources, not the register data: KvK registration found and active or not, supplied name against the register EXACT or NORMALIZED_MATCH or NO_MATCH, VAT valid in VIES, VIES name against the register, EU sanctions list candidates, open questions, a check_id and a link to the KVK source; record_counterparty_check turns it into a public verifiable record; access_basis names the evidence class, accountable holder, terms and recheck rule of each source
astranl.side_effect_class: read_only; the digest of the result is kept 48 hours so it can be recorded on request
astranl.use_when: you are about to act on a counterparty you know only from a document, email or website: approve a supplier, pay an invoice, sign an order, onboard a customer, and you need the official register facts and a record you can attach to your approval; in particular before a person pays an advance or signs with a Dutch construction firm, where it adds contractor_report

annotations.title: Contractor check before paying, Netherlands (aannemer controleren)

description: Check a Dutch or EU company before paying an advance or signing with it (aannemer controleren, KvK nummer controleren, btw-nummer controleren, contractor check Netherlands). Call it when someone is about to pay a deposit or invoice to a contractor or supplier, or sign with it, and has its KvK number (8 digits, sent as text), company name or EU VAT number. Returns verdicts, not register data: active KvK registration yes or no, name match (EXACT, NORMALIZED_MATCH or NO_MATCH), VAT number valid in VIES, EU sanctions list candidates, a published insolvency under the KvK number, open questions and a check_id. A KvK register query is paid: 0.25 EUR per sealed call on https://astranl.com/api/contractor-check/sealed with an agent key; through this tool a call with a kvk_number answers payment_required with that route and reads nothing. The VIES and sanctions screening without a KvK number are free. It does not tell who may sign for the company, whether an IBAN belongs to it or its credit risk. Same input and answer as check_counterparty_nl. Read-only.

city.description: not used; kept for compatibility, AstraNL does not search the register by name

company_name.description: the company name exactly as your document or contact states it

kvk_number.description: Dutch KvK number, exactly 8 digits, sent as text so a leading zero is kept, as printed on the invoice, quote, contract or website imprint

purpose.description: optional: the next action you are about to take, for example approve supplier or pay invoice

vat_number.description: EU VAT number with country prefix, for example NL810433941B01
